### Added
- **A serving preset's ConfigMap names the chart version that published it** (giantswarm/model-manager#216). `agent-platform-serving-preset-<name>` carries the annotation `agent-platform.giantswarm.io/chart-version` with the connectivity chart's version verbatim (Helm's `+` build metadata included, which the `helm.sh/chart` label cannot carry), and model-manager reports it as the preset's `chartVersion`, so a benchmark records the release that shipped its preset instead of a hand-typed one. `make verify-serving-slice` asserts the annotation on every preset ConfigMap; `verify-gpu-pool` leaves it out of the `GOLDEN_REF` comparison, as it does the image references.
